t: Hiện tại hoàn thành & quá khứ đơn
th: **have / has + V3**. Dùng cho: kinh nghiệm (I have been to Japan); việc vừa xảy ra còn ảnh hưởng (I've lost my keys); trạng thái kéo dài đến nay với **for / since**.
**have / has + past participle**. Use it for experience (I have been to Japan), recent events with present results (I've lost my keys), and situations continuing up to now with **for / since**.
**for** + khoảng thời gian (for three years); **since** + mốc thời gian (since 2020, since I was a child).
**for** + a period (for three years); **since** + a starting point (since 2020, since I was a child).
**ever / never**, **already / just** (câu khẳng định), **yet** (phủ định và câu hỏi, cuối câu): Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.
**ever / never**, **already / just** (positive), **yet** (negatives and questions, at the end): Have you finished yet? I haven't finished yet.
Có thời điểm đã kết thúc (yesterday, in 2019, last year, ago) → **quá khứ đơn**: I went to Japan in 2019. (Sai: I have gone to Japan in 2019.)
With a finished time (yesterday, in 2019, last year, ago) → **past simple**: I went to Japan in 2019. (Wrong: I have gone to Japan in 2019.)
ex: Có mốc quá khứ (in 2019) → quá khứ đơn.
We have known each other ___ ten years.
He has worked here ___ last March.
Bạn đã bao giờ ăn sầu riêng chưa?
I have just finished my report.

warm.s: I have lived in Da Nang since I finished university, but I spent my first two years after graduation working in a small hotel in Hoi An.
q: Người nói sống ở Đà Nẵng từ khi nào?
Since when has the speaker lived in Da Nang?
o: Từ khi học xong đại học
Từ khi làm ở khách sạn Hội An
Since working at the hotel in Hoi An
e: “have lived … since I finished university”: hiện tại hoàn thành + since chỉ việc bắt đầu từ lúc tốt nghiệp và vẫn kéo dài đến nay. Hai năm ở Hội An là chuyện đã kết thúc nên dùng quá khứ đơn (spent).

“have lived … since I finished university”: present perfect + since shows a situation that began at graduation and continues now. The two years in Hoi An are finished, so the speaker uses the past simple (spent).
f: have lived in Da Nang since

warm.s: We have already booked the tickets for the concert, but we haven't decided where to have dinner before the show yet.
e: Chú ý vị trí: already đứng giữa have và V3; yet đứng cuối câu phủ định. Viết đúng dạng rút gọn haven't.
Note the positions: already goes between have and the past participle; yet goes at the end of the negative clause. Spell the contraction haven't correctly.

warm.s: Have you ever tried to learn a language on your own, or have you always studied with a teacher in a classroom?
e: Nhấn vào ever và always; lên giọng ở cuối vế hỏi thứ nhất, xuống giọng ở cuối câu hỏi lựa chọn.
Stress ever and always; rise at the end of the first option and fall at the end of the choice question.

rd2.tx:
Hi Minh,
I'm sorry I haven't written for so long. A lot has happened since we last met. In March I left my job at the bank, and two weeks later I started working for a small travel company in Hue. I have already visited more places this year than in the previous five years together! Last month I took a group of Australian tourists to Phong Nha, and they loved the caves. The work is hard, and I haven't had a proper day off since Tet, but I have never felt so happy at work. I have also started learning Korean, because many of our customers come from Seoul. I haven't made much progress yet, but I practise every evening. Have you finished your master's degree yet? Write soon!
Lan
rd2.tr:
Chào Minh,
Xin lỗi vì lâu lắm rồi mình không viết thư. Từ lần cuối gặp nhau đến giờ có nhiều chuyện lắm. Hồi tháng Ba mình nghỉ việc ở ngân hàng, và hai tuần sau mình bắt đầu làm cho một công ty du lịch nhỏ ở Huế. Năm nay mình đã đi nhiều nơi hơn cả năm năm trước cộng lại! Tháng trước mình dẫn một đoàn khách Úc đi Phong Nha, và họ mê mấy cái hang lắm. Công việc vất vả, từ Tết đến giờ mình chưa được nghỉ một ngày tử tế nào, nhưng mình chưa bao giờ thấy vui với công việc như thế này. Mình cũng bắt đầu học tiếng Hàn, vì nhiều khách của công ty đến từ Seoul. Mình chưa tiến bộ được mấy, nhưng tối nào mình cũng luyện. Cậu học xong thạc sĩ chưa? Nhớ viết thư sớm nhé!
Lan

q: Lan nghỉ việc ở ngân hàng khi nào?
When did Lan leave her job at the bank?
e: Bài viết: “In March I left my job at the bank”. Có mốc thời gian đã kết thúc (in March) nên Lan dùng quá khứ đơn. “Two weeks later” là lúc cô bắt đầu việc mới, không phải lúc nghỉ việc.
The text says “In March I left my job at the bank”. A finished time (in March) needs the past simple. “Two weeks later” is when she started the new job, not when she left.
f: In March I left my job at the bank

q: Vì sao Lan bắt đầu học tiếng Hàn?
Why has Lan started learning Korean?
o: Vì nhiều khách hàng đến từ Seoul
Because many customers come from Seoul
Vì cô muốn chuyển sang Hàn Quốc sống
Because she wants to move to Korea
Vì Minh đang học thạc sĩ ở Seoul
Because Minh is doing a master's in Seoul
e: Lý do nằm ngay sau because: “many of our customers come from Seoul”. Bài không nhắc đến việc chuyển nhà hay Minh học ở đâu.
The reason follows because: “many of our customers come from Seoul”. The text says nothing about moving to Korea or where Minh studies.
f: because many of our customers come from Seoul

q: Câu nào ĐÚNG theo bức thư?
Which statement is TRUE according to the email?
o: Từ Tết đến giờ Lan chưa được nghỉ ngày nào ra hồn
Lan hasn't had a proper day off since Tet
Lan đã học xong tiếng Hàn
Lan đưa khách đi Phong Nha từ năm ngoái
Lan took tourists to Phong Nha last year
e: “I haven't had a proper day off since Tet” – hiện tại hoàn thành phủ định + since: tình trạng kéo dài đến bây giờ. Chuyến Phong Nha là “last month”, còn tiếng Hàn thì cô “haven't made much progress yet”.

“I haven't had a proper day off since Tet” – negative present perfect + since: a situation continuing up to now. The Phong Nha trip was “last month”, and with Korean she “hasn't made much progress yet”.
f: I haven't had a proper day off since Tet

ex2.s: My brother ___ in Singapore for three years, but he moved back to Vietnam last summer because he missed our family so much.
e: Anh trai đã về nước (moved back last summer), nên quãng ba năm ở Singapore đã kết thúc hoàn toàn → quá khứ đơn worked. Bẫy: thấy “for three years” là chọn hiện tại hoàn thành, nhưng has worked có nghĩa là anh ấy vẫn đang làm ở đó.

He has moved back (last summer), so the three years in Singapore are completely finished → past simple worked. Trap: “for three years” tempts you to use the present perfect, but has worked would mean he still works there.

ex2.s: I ___ (not / see) my grandparents since Tet, so I am planning to visit them in the countryside next weekend.
a: haven't seen
have not seen
e: “since Tet” là mốc bắt đầu, và việc chưa gặp vẫn kéo dài đến nay → hiện tại hoàn thành phủ định haven't seen. Không dùng didn't see với since.
“since Tet” is a starting point, and not seeing them continues until now → negative present perfect haven't seen. Don't use didn't see with since.

ex2.s: I have visited the old town of Hoi An two years ago, and I still remember the colourful lanterns along the river at night.
a: I visited the old town of Hoi An two years ago, and I still remember the colourful lanterns along the river at night.
e: “two years ago” là thời điểm đã kết thúc, nên phải dùng quá khứ đơn visited. Hiện tại hoàn thành không bao giờ đi với ago, yesterday, last year, in 2019.
“two years ago” is a finished time, so you need the past simple visited. The present perfect never goes with ago, yesterday, last year or in 2019.

ex2.s: Tôi đã học tiếng Anh được năm năm, nhưng tôi chưa bao giờ nói chuyện trực tiếp với một người bản xứ.
a: I have studied English for five years, but I have never spoken directly to a native speaker.
I've studied English for five years, but I've never spoken directly to a native speaker.
I have been studying English for five years, but I have never talked to a native speaker in person.
I have learned English for five years, but I have never spoken to a native speaker face to face.
e: “được năm năm” và vẫn đang học → have studied / have been studying + for five years. “chưa bao giờ” → have never + V3 (spoken/talked). Không dùng studied (quá khứ đơn) vì việc học chưa kết thúc.
“for five years” and still studying → have studied / have been studying. “never (up to now)” → have never + past participle. Don't use the past simple studied, because the studying hasn't ended.
f: have studied English for five years

q: Viết lại câu dùng “since”, giữ nguyên nghĩa
Rewrite the sentence using “since” without changing the meaning
ex2.s: The last time I spoke to my old classmate from high school was in 2019, when we met at a friend's wedding.
a: I haven't spoken to my old classmate from high school since 2019, when we met at a friend's wedding.
I have not spoken to my old classmate from high school since 2019, when we met at a friend's wedding.
e: “The last time … was in 2019” = từ 2019 đến nay chưa nói chuyện lại → haven't spoken … since 2019. Mệnh đề “when we met” vẫn ở quá khứ đơn vì nói về một sự kiện đã xong.
“The last time … was in 2019” means no contact from 2019 until now → haven't spoken … since 2019. The clause “when we met” stays in the past simple because it is a finished event.

ex2.s: Have you ever|been to|a country|where you|couldn't understand|a single word|of the local language?
m: Bạn đã bao giờ đến một đất nước mà bạn không hiểu nổi một từ nào của tiếng địa phương chưa?
Have you ever been to a country where you couldn't understand a single word of the local language?
e: Câu hỏi kinh nghiệm: Have you ever + V3 (been to). Mệnh đề quan hệ “where you couldn't understand…” bổ nghĩa cho a country và dùng quá khứ vì nói về lúc ở đó.

An experience question: Have you ever + past participle (been to). The relative clause “where you couldn't understand…” describes a country and is in the past because it refers to the time you were there.

th: **Loại 0** – sự thật: If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn. If you heat ice, it melts.
**Zero** – facts: If + present simple, present simple. If you heat ice, it melts.
**Loại 1** – có thể xảy ra: If + hiện tại đơn, **will** + V. If it rains, we will stay home. Không dùng will trong mệnh đề if.
**First** – real possibility: If + present simple, **will** + V. If it rains, we will stay home. No will in the if-clause.
**Loại 2** – không có thật / khó xảy ra ở hiện tại: If + quá khứ đơn, **would** + V. If I had more time, I would learn Chinese. Với to be có thể dùng **were** cho mọi ngôi: If I were you, I'd…
**Second** – unreal or unlikely now: If + past simple, **would** + V. If I had more time, I would learn Chinese. With be, **were** is used for all persons: If I were you, I'd…
**unless** = if … not: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
**unless** = if … not: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
vo: to turn from solid to liquid
a game of chance with prizes
ex: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
If you heat water to 100°C, it ___ .
“If I were you, I'd…” dùng để?
“If I were you, I'd…” is used to?
What would you do if you ___ the lottery?
If I had more time I would learn to cook
Nếu có thêm thời gian, tôi sẽ học nấu ăn.
If you need help, call me.

warm.s: If the weather stays fine this weekend, we will take the children to the beach, but if it rains, we'll probably go to the museum instead.
q: Nếu trời mưa, họ sẽ làm gì?
What will they do if it rains?
e: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (If + hiện tại đơn, will + V) nói về khả năng có thật: “if it rains, we'll probably go to the museum instead”. Instead = thay vì đi biển.
A first conditional (If + present simple, will + V) for a real possibility: “if it rains, we'll probably go to the museum instead”. Instead = rather than the beach.
f: if it rains, we'll probably go to the museum

warm.s: If I had a bit more free time in the evenings, I would join a cooking class near my office.
e: Loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn (had), would + V (would join) cho tình huống không có thật ở hiện tại. Đừng viết “will join”.
Second conditional: If + past simple (had), would + V (would join) for an unreal present situation. Don't write “will join”.

warm.s: Unless you water these plants at least twice a week, they will dry out very quickly in the hot season.
e: Nhấn vào unless và twice; ngắt hơi nhẹ sau “twice a week”, trước mệnh đề chính.
Stress unless and twice; pause briefly after “twice a week”, before the main clause.

rd2.tx:
Dear Thu,
I'm twenty-five and I work in an office in Ho Chi Minh City. My dream is to work abroad, but my English isn't good enough yet. If I had more money, I would quit my job and study full-time, but I can't afford it. What should I do?
Khoa

Dear Khoa,
You don't need to quit your job. If you study for thirty minutes every morning before work, you will see real progress in six months. If you want to practise speaking, join an online conversation club; most of them are free. And remember: if you never make mistakes, you never learn. If I were you, I would also set a clear goal, such as an IELTS score, because a goal keeps you motivated. Unless you have a deadline, it is easy to give up.
Good luck!
Thu
rd2.tr:
Chị Thu thân mến,
Em 25 tuổi và làm văn phòng ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh. Ước mơ của em là được làm việc ở nước ngoài, nhưng tiếng Anh của em chưa đủ tốt. Nếu có nhiều tiền hơn, em sẽ nghỉ việc để học toàn thời gian, nhưng em không đủ khả năng. Em nên làm gì ạ?
Khoa

Khoa thân mến,
Em không cần nghỉ việc đâu. Nếu mỗi sáng em học ba mươi phút trước giờ làm, sau sáu tháng em sẽ thấy tiến bộ thật sự. Nếu muốn luyện nói, hãy tham gia một câu lạc bộ trò chuyện trực tuyến; phần lớn đều miễn phí. Và nhớ nhé: nếu không bao giờ mắc lỗi thì sẽ không bao giờ học được. Nếu chị là em, chị sẽ đặt một mục tiêu rõ ràng, chẳng hạn một mức điểm IELTS, vì mục tiêu giúp em giữ động lực. Nếu không có hạn chót thì rất dễ bỏ cuộc.
Chúc em may mắn!
Thu

q: Vì sao Khoa không nghỉ việc để học toàn thời gian?
Why doesn't Khoa quit his job to study full-time?
o: Vì anh rất thích công việc hiện tại
Because he loves his current job
Because his boss won't allow it
e: “If I had more money, I would quit my job… but I can't afford it” – câu loại 2 cho thấy việc nghỉ việc chỉ là giả định, vì thực tế anh không đủ tiền.
“If I had more money, I would quit my job… but I can't afford it” – the second conditional shows quitting is only imagined, because in reality he can't afford it.

q: Theo Thu, điều gì sẽ xảy ra nếu Khoa học 30 phút mỗi sáng?
According to Thu, what will happen if Khoa studies for 30 minutes every morning?
o: Anh sẽ thấy tiến bộ thật sự sau sáu tháng
He will see real progress in six months
Anh sẽ đạt IELTS ngay lập tức
He will get an IELTS score immediately
He will have to quit his job
e: Câu loại 1: “If you study for thirty minutes every morning…, you will see real progress in six months.” Đây là kết quả có thể xảy ra trong tương lai.
First conditional: “If you study for thirty minutes every morning…, you will see real progress in six months.” It is a likely future result.
f: you will see real progress in six months

q: Vì sao Thu khuyên đặt mục tiêu rõ ràng?
Why does Thu recommend setting a clear goal?
o: Vì mục tiêu giúp giữ động lực
Because a goal keeps you motivated
Vì thi IELTS là bắt buộc
Because the IELTS exam is compulsory
Vì câu lạc bộ trực tuyến yêu cầu
e: Lý do nằm sau because: “a goal keeps you motivated”. Câu tiếp theo cũng nói: không có hạn chót thì dễ bỏ cuộc.
The reason follows because: “a goal keeps you motivated”. The next sentence adds that without a deadline it is easy to give up.
f: because a goal keeps you motivated

ex2.s: If water ___ to zero degrees Celsius, it turns into ice, which is why the roads in some countries become dangerous in winter.
e: Câu loại 0 nói về sự thật khoa học: If + hiện tại đơn, hiện tại đơn (cools … turns). Không bao giờ dùng will trong mệnh đề if.
A zero conditional for a scientific fact: If + present simple, present simple (cools … turns). Never use will in the if-clause.

ex2.s: If I ___ (be) you, I would talk to the manager before you sign the contract, because the conditions seem rather unfair.
a: were
was
e: Lời khuyên với loại 2: If I were you, I would… Dạng chuẩn là were cho mọi ngôi; was được chấp nhận trong văn nói thân mật, nhưng khi viết và đi thi hãy dùng were.
Advice with the second conditional: If I were you, I would… The standard form is were for every person; was is accepted in casual speech, but use were in writing and exams.

ex2.s: If you will finish your report before Friday, the manager will probably let you leave early for the long holiday weekend.
a: If you finish your report before Friday, the manager will probably let you leave early for the long holiday weekend.
e: Trong câu loại 1, mệnh đề if dùng hiện tại đơn (If you finish), còn will chỉ nằm ở mệnh đề chính. Đây là lỗi rất hay gặp vì tiếng Việt có “sẽ” ở cả hai vế.
In the first conditional, the if-clause uses the present simple (If you finish); will belongs only in the main clause. This is a very common mistake because Vietnamese can put “sẽ” in both parts.

ex2.s: Nếu tôi sống gần biển, tôi sẽ đi bơi mỗi sáng trước khi đi làm.
a: If I lived near the sea, I would go swimming every morning before going to work.
If I lived near the sea, I'd go swimming every morning before work.
If I lived by the sea, I would go swimming every morning before I went to work.
If I lived near the beach, I would go for a swim every morning before work.
e: Thực tế tôi không sống gần biển → loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn (lived), would + V (would go). Dùng “If I live…, I will go” là sai nghĩa vì đó là khả năng có thật.
In reality I don't live near the sea → second conditional: If + past simple (lived), would + V (would go). “If I live…, I will go” changes the meaning to a real possibility.
f: If I lived near the sea, I would go

q: Viết lại câu dùng “unless”
Rewrite the sentence using “unless”
ex2.s: If you don't book a table in advance, you won't get a seat at that restaurant on Saturday evenings.
a: Unless you book a table in advance, you won't get a seat at that restaurant on Saturday evenings.
Unless you book a table in advance, you will not get a seat at that restaurant on Saturday evenings.
You won't get a seat at that restaurant on Saturday evenings unless you book a table in advance.
e: Unless = if … not, nên bỏ don't: Unless you book. Bẫy: viết “Unless you don't book” là thành phủ định hai lần, sai nghĩa.
Unless = if … not, so remove don't: Unless you book. Trap: “Unless you don't book” is a double negative and changes the meaning.
f: Unless you book a table in advance

ex2.s: What would you do|if you|found a wallet|full of money|in the street|on your way|home from work?
m: Bạn sẽ làm gì nếu nhặt được một chiếc ví đầy tiền trên đường đi làm về?
What would you do if you found a wallet full of money in the street on your way home from work?
e: Câu hỏi giả định loại 2: What would you do + if + quá khứ đơn (found). Tình huống khó xảy ra nên không dùng will/find.
A second-conditional question: What would you do + if + past simple (found). The situation is unlikely, so will/find are not used.
f: What would you do if you found

th: Cấu trúc: **be + V3**. Dùng khi hành động quan trọng hơn người làm, hoặc không biết ai làm: This bridge was built in 1902.
Form: **be + past participle**. Use it when the action matters more than the doer, or the doer is unknown: This bridge was built in 1902.

Thì nằm ở động từ be:
• is made (hiện tại) – was made (quá khứ)
• has been made – will be made
• is being made – can be made

The tense is shown by be:
• is made – was made
• has been made – will be made
• is being made – can be made
Thêm **by + người làm** khi thông tin đó quan trọng: The Tale of Kieu was written by Nguyen Du.
Add **by + agent** only when it matters: The Tale of Kieu was written by Nguyen Du.
ex: Chuyển sang bị động: “They are repairing the road.”
Make passive: “They are repairing the road.”
This novel was translated into Vietnamese
Cuốn tiểu thuyết này đã được dịch sang tiếng Việt.
The letters are delivered every morning.

warm.s: The new bridge across the river is being built by a Japanese company, and it will be opened to traffic next spring.
q: Khi nào cây cầu sẽ thông xe?
When will the bridge open to traffic?
e: “is being built” = đang được xây (hiện tại tiếp diễn bị động); “will be opened … next spring” = sẽ được thông xe vào mùa xuân năm sau.
“is being built” = under construction now (present continuous passive); “will be opened … next spring” = it opens next spring.
f: will be opened to traffic next spring

warm.s: All the letters and parcels are sorted at the central post office before they are delivered to homes in the area.
e: Hai động từ bị động hiện tại đơn: are sorted, are delivered. Nhớ đuôi -ed và chữ “parcels”.
Two present simple passives: are sorted, are delivered. Remember the -ed endings and the spelling of “parcels”.

warm.s: This temple was built more than eight hundred years ago, and it has been restored several times since then.
e: Đọc rõ “was built” và “has been restored”; âm /d/ cuối restored nối nhẹ sang “several”.
Say “was built” and “has been restored” clearly; link the final /d/ of restored to “several”.

rd2.tx: Coffee was brought to Vietnam by the French in the nineteenth century. Today, Vietnam is one of the largest coffee producers in the world, and most of its coffee is grown in the Central Highlands, especially in Dak Lak. The main type that is grown there is robusta, which is stronger and more bitter than arabica. After the coffee cherries are picked, they are dried in the sun for several days. Then the beans are removed, sorted and roasted. A large part of the harvest is exported, but more and more coffee is also drunk at home, in thousands of small cafés. In many of them, coffee is still made with a phin, a small metal filter that is placed on top of the cup. Egg coffee, which was invented in Hanoi in the 1940s, is now enjoyed by visitors from all over the world.
rd2.tr: Cà phê được người Pháp đưa vào Việt Nam từ thế kỷ 19. Ngày nay, Việt Nam là một trong những nước sản xuất cà phê lớn nhất thế giới, và phần lớn cà phê được trồng ở Tây Nguyên, nhất là Đắk Lắk. Loại được trồng nhiều nhất ở đó là robusta, đậm và đắng hơn arabica. Sau khi quả cà phê được hái, chúng được phơi nắng trong vài ngày. Sau đó hạt được tách ra, phân loại và rang. Một phần lớn sản lượng được xuất khẩu, nhưng ngày càng nhiều cà phê cũng được uống ngay trong nước, ở hàng nghìn quán nhỏ. Ở nhiều quán, cà phê vẫn được pha bằng phin, một chiếc lọc kim loại nhỏ đặt trên miệng cốc. Cà phê trứng, được sáng tạo ở Hà Nội vào những năm 1940, nay được du khách khắp thế giới yêu thích.

q: Ai đã đưa cà phê vào Việt Nam?
Who brought coffee to Vietnam?
e: Câu bị động có “by + người làm”: “Coffee was brought to Vietnam by the French”. Người làm hành động đứng sau by.
A passive with “by + agent”: “Coffee was brought to Vietnam by the French”. The doer comes after by.
f: Coffee was brought to Vietnam by the French

q: Việc gì được làm ngay sau khi hái quả cà phê?
What happens right after the coffee cherries are picked?
o: Quả được phơi nắng vài ngày
They are dried in the sun for several days
e: “After the coffee cherries are picked, they are dried in the sun for several days.” Việc tách, phân loại và rang hạt đến sau (Then…).
“After the coffee cherries are picked, they are dried in the sun for several days.” Removing, sorting and roasting come later (Then…).
f: they are dried in the sun for several days

q: Cà phê trứng ra đời ở đâu?
Where was egg coffee invented?
e: Mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: “Egg coffee, which was invented in Hanoi in the 1940s…”. Pháp chỉ liên quan đến việc đưa cà phê vào Việt Nam.
A passive relative clause: “Egg coffee, which was invented in Hanoi in the 1940s…”. France is only linked to bringing coffee to Vietnam.
f: which was invented in Hanoi in the 1940s

ex2.s: More than a thousand new apartments ___ in this area since the metro line opened, so the traffic has become much worse.
e: Căn hộ không tự xây → bị động; có since → hiện tại hoàn thành: have been built. “have built” là chủ động (căn hộ đi xây cái gì đó), sai nghĩa.
Apartments don't build anything → passive; since → present perfect: have been built. “have built” is active and would mean the apartments built something.

ex2.s: The winners of the photography competition ___ (announce) on the school website next Monday, so please check it then.
a: will be announced
are going to be announced
are to be announced
e: Người thắng được công bố (bị động) vào thứ Hai tới (tương lai) → will be + V3: will be announced. Đừng quên be và đuôi -ed.
The winners are announced by someone (passive) next Monday (future) → will be + past participle: will be announced. Don't forget be and the -ed ending.

ex2.s: My laptop was stole from my car while I was having lunch in a restaurant near the office last Friday.
a: My laptop was stolen from my car while I was having lunch in a restaurant near the office last Friday.
e: Bị động cần V3: steal – stole – stolen, nên phải là was stolen. “stole” chỉ là quá khứ đơn chủ động.
The passive needs the past participle: steal – stole – stolen, so it must be was stolen. “stole” is only the active past simple.

q: Viết lại câu ở thể bị động, bắt đầu bằng “The beach…”
Rewrite the sentence in the passive, starting with “The beach…”
ex2.s: A team of volunteers cleans the beach every Sunday morning before the tourists arrive from the city.
a: The beach is cleaned by a team of volunteers every Sunday morning before the tourists arrive from the city.
The beach is cleaned every Sunday morning by a team of volunteers before the tourists arrive from the city.
e: Tân ngữ the beach thành chủ ngữ; thì hiện tại đơn giữ nguyên ở be: is cleaned. Người làm được nêu bằng by vì thông tin “tình nguyện viên” quan trọng.
The object the beach becomes the subject; the present simple stays in be: is cleaned. The agent is kept with by because “volunteers” is important information.
f: The beach is cleaned by a team of volunteers

ex2.s: Cuốn tiểu thuyết này đã được dịch sang hơn hai mươi thứ tiếng và đang được chuyển thể thành phim.
a: This novel has been translated into more than twenty languages and is being made into a film.
This novel has been translated into over twenty languages and is being made into a movie.
This novel has been translated into more than twenty languages and is being adapted into a film.
This novel has been translated into more than twenty languages and is now being made into a film.
e: “đã được dịch” (kết quả đến nay) → has been translated; “đang được chuyển thể” → is being made / adapted (bị động tiếp diễn). Dùng into, không dùng to, sau translate.
“has been translated” for a result up to now; “is being made / adapted” for the continuous passive. Use into, not to, after translate.

ex2.s: Visitors|are not allowed|to take photos|inside the museum,|but postcards|of the paintings|can be bought|in the gift shop.
m: Khách tham quan không được phép chụp ảnh trong bảo tàng, nhưng có thể mua bưu thiếp in các bức tranh ở cửa hàng quà tặng.
Visitors are not allowed to take photos inside the museum, but postcards of the paintings can be bought in the gift shop.
e: Hai cấu trúc bị động: are not allowed to + V (không được phép) và can be bought (động từ khuyết thiếu + be + V3).
Two passive patterns: are not allowed to + V and can be bought (modal + be + past participle).

th: **who** – người; **which** – vật; **that** – người hoặc vật (mệnh đề xác định); **whose** – sở hữu; **where** – nơi chốn; **when** – thời gian.
**who** – people; **which** – things; **that** – people or things (defining clauses); **whose** – possession; **where** – places; **when** – times.
**Mệnh đề xác định**: cần thiết để biết ai/cái gì, không có dấu phẩy. The man who lives next door is a doctor.
**Defining clauses** identify who/what, no commas. The man who lives next door is a doctor.
**Mệnh đề không xác định**: chỉ thêm thông tin, có dấu phẩy, **không dùng that**. My father, who is 60, still works.
**Non-defining clauses** add extra information, use commas, and **never use that**. My father, who is 60, still works.
Có thể bỏ đại từ quan hệ khi nó là **tân ngữ** trong mệnh đề xác định: The book (that) I bought is great.
You can drop the pronoun when it is the **object** of a defining clause: The book (that) I bought is great.
vo: the main city of a country
a person who cares for patients
ex: The woman ___ called you is my aunt.
This is the house ___ I was born.
I have a friend ___ brother is a pilot.
Hanoi, ___ is the capital, has many lakes.
Mệnh đề có dấu phẩy không dùng that.
Câu nào có thể bỏ đại từ quan hệ?
In which sentence can the pronoun be dropped?
The man who called me was angry.
The film that we watched was boring.
My mother, who is a nurse, works nights.
that là tân ngữ của watched.
that is the object of watched.
Chiếc điện thoại mà tôi mua tuần trước đã bị hỏng.
The phone who I bought last week is broken.
The phone that I bought last week is broken.
The phone, that I bought last week, is broken.
The city where I grew up is very small
Thành phố nơi tôi lớn lên rất nhỏ.
My neighbour, who is a nurse, works at night.

warm.s: The teacher who helped me most at university was a woman whose parents had moved to Vietnam from France in the nineteen-sixties.
q: Ta biết gì về bố mẹ của cô giáo?
What do we know about the teacher's parents?
o: Họ chuyển từ Pháp sang Việt Nam
They moved to Vietnam from France
Họ dạy ở trường đại học đó
They taught at the same university
Họ sinh ra ở Việt Nam
e: “whose parents had moved to Vietnam from France” – whose chỉ sở hữu: bố mẹ của cô giáo. Mệnh đề “who helped me most” chỉ xác định cô giáo nào.
“whose parents had moved to Vietnam from France” – whose shows possession: the teacher's parents. “who helped me most” only identifies which teacher.
f: whose parents had moved to Vietnam from France

warm.s: The café where we usually meet on Saturdays has closed, so we need to find another place that is quiet enough to study.
e: where thay cho nơi chốn (the café), that thay cho vật (another place). Chú ý “quiet” (yên tĩnh), không nhầm với “quite”.
where refers to a place (the café), that to a thing (another place). Spell “quiet” (not noisy), not “quite”.

warm.s: My grandmother, who is eighty-five this year, still walks around the lake every morning with her friends.
e: Mệnh đề không xác định nằm giữa hai dấu phẩy: hạ giọng và ngắt nhẹ trước và sau “who is eighty-five this year”.
A non-defining clause sits between commas: lower your voice and pause slightly before and after “who is eighty-five this year”.

rd2.tx: I grew up in Ninh Binh, a province which is famous for its limestone mountains and rice fields. The house where I was born is still there, although my parents moved to the city when I was twelve. My best friend from childhood, whose family owned a small boat, often took me along the river on summer afternoons. The places that we visited are now full of tourists, because the area became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2014. Last month I went back with my husband, who had never been there. We stayed with Mrs Hoa, the woman who used to sell us ice cream after school. She remembered me immediately. It was a trip that I will never forget, and the photos which we took are now on our kitchen wall.
rd2.tr: Tôi lớn lên ở Ninh Bình, một tỉnh nổi tiếng với núi đá vôi và ruộng lúa. Ngôi nhà nơi tôi sinh ra vẫn còn đó, dù bố mẹ tôi đã chuyển lên thành phố khi tôi mười hai tuổi. Người bạn thân thời thơ ấu của tôi, nhà có một chiếc thuyền nhỏ, thường chở tôi đi dọc sông vào những buổi chiều hè. Những nơi chúng tôi từng đến giờ đầy khách du lịch, vì khu vực này trở thành Di sản Thế giới UNESCO năm 2014. Tháng trước tôi về lại cùng chồng, người chưa từng đến đó. Chúng tôi ở nhà bà Hoa, người ngày xưa hay bán kem cho chúng tôi sau giờ học. Bà nhận ra tôi ngay. Đó là chuyến đi tôi sẽ không bao giờ quên, và những bức ảnh chúng tôi chụp giờ được treo trên tường bếp.

q: Vì sao những nơi tác giả từng đến giờ đông khách du lịch?
Why are the places the writer visited now full of tourists?
o: Vì khu vực trở thành Di sản Thế giới năm 2014
Because the area became a World Heritage site in 2014
Because a new bridge was built
Vì bà Hoa mở khách sạn
Because Mrs Hoa opened a hotel
e: Lý do nằm sau because: “the area became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2014”. “The places that we visited” là mệnh đề xác định, cho biết đó là những nơi nào.
The reason follows because: “the area became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2014”. “The places that we visited” is a defining clause telling us which places.
f: because the area became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2014

q: Bà Hoa là ai?
Who is Mrs Hoa?
o: Người ngày xưa bán kem cho tác giả
The woman who used to sell the writer ice cream
Cô giáo cũ của tác giả
e: “Mrs Hoa, the woman who used to sell us ice cream after school” – mệnh đề who cho biết bà là ai.
“Mrs Hoa, the woman who used to sell us ice cream after school” – the who-clause tells us who she is.
f: the woman who used to sell us ice cream after school

q: Gia đình người bạn thân có gì?
What did the best friend's family own?
o: Một ngôi nhà ở thành phố
e: whose = của người đó: “whose family owned a small boat” → gia đình của người bạn có một chiếc thuyền nhỏ.
whose = belonging to that person: “whose family owned a small boat” → the friend's family had a small boat.
f: whose family owned a small boat

ex2.s: Ms Lan, ___ has taught at this school for more than twenty years, is retiring at the end of this term.
e: Mệnh đề có dấu phẩy (không xác định) về người → who. Không dùng that sau dấu phẩy; which chỉ dùng cho vật.
A non-defining clause (with commas) about a person → who. That is never used after a comma; which is for things.

ex2.s: I still remember the summer ___ we drove all the way from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City in my father's old car.
a: when
that
in which
e: the summer là danh từ chỉ thời gian, và mệnh đề phía sau đã đủ chủ ngữ, tân ngữ → when (hoặc that / in which). Không dùng which một mình vì thiếu giới từ.
the summer is a time noun, and the clause after it is complete → when (or that / in which). Plain which doesn't work without a preposition.

ex2.s: The man which repaired our air conditioner yesterday forgot his tools, so he is coming back this afternoon to collect them.
a: The man who repaired our air conditioner yesterday forgot his tools, so he is coming back this afternoon to collect them.
The man that repaired our air conditioner yesterday forgot his tools, so he is coming back this afternoon to collect them.
e: The man là người → who (hoặc that trong mệnh đề xác định). which chỉ dùng cho đồ vật, con vật.
The man is a person → who (or that in a defining clause). which is only for things and animals.

ex2.s: Người phụ nữ có con gái học cùng lớp với tôi là bác sĩ ở bệnh viện lớn nhất thành phố.
a: The woman whose daughter is in my class is a doctor at the biggest hospital in the city.
The woman whose daughter studies in the same class as me is a doctor at the largest hospital in the city.
The woman whose daughter is in the same class as me is a doctor at the biggest hospital in the city.
e: “có con gái…” = con gái của người phụ nữ → whose daughter. Sai thường gặp: “The woman who her daughter…” hoặc “The woman who's daughter…”.
“whose daughter” = the woman's daughter. Common mistakes: “The woman who her daughter…” or “The woman who's daughter…”.

q: Nối hai câu bằng mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (có dấu phẩy)
Join the two sentences with a non-defining relative clause (use commas)
ex2.s: Da Lat is a city in the Central Highlands. It is popular with couples because of its cool weather and flower gardens.
a: Da Lat, which is a city in the Central Highlands, is popular with couples because of its cool weather and flower gardens.
Da Lat, which is popular with couples because of its cool weather and flower gardens, is a city in the Central Highlands.
e: Đà Lạt là tên riêng nên mệnh đề chỉ thêm thông tin → dùng which giữa hai dấu phẩy, không dùng that, và bỏ chủ ngữ It ở câu thứ hai.
Da Lat is a proper noun, so the clause just adds information → which between commas, never that, and drop the subject It from the second sentence.

ex2.s: The book|that you lent me|last month|was so interesting|that I finished it|in just|two days.
m: Cuốn sách bạn cho tôi mượn tháng trước hay đến mức tôi đọc xong chỉ trong hai ngày.
The book that you lent me last month was so interesting that I finished it in just two days.
e: “that you lent me last month” là mệnh đề xác định bổ nghĩa cho The book; that ở đây là tân ngữ nên có thể lược bỏ. Cấu trúc so … that chỉ kết quả.
“that you lent me last month” is a defining clause for The book; that is the object, so it could be dropped. so … that shows the result.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – hiện tại hoàn thành với for / since:** have/has + V3 cho tình trạng bắt đầu trong quá khứ và **vẫn còn đến bây giờ**. **for** + khoảng thời gian (for three days, for a week); **since** + mốc thời gian (since Monday, since yesterday).
• I've had a headache since yesterday.
• She has had a cough for three days.
• How long have you felt like this?

**Grammar 1 – present perfect with for / since:** have/has + past participle for a situation that started in the past and **continues now**. **for** + a period (for three days, for a week); **since** + a starting point (since Monday, since yesterday).
• I've had a headache since yesterday.
• She has had a cough for three days.
• How long have you felt like this?

**Ngữ pháp 2 – should / shouldn't để khuyên:** should + động từ nguyên mẫu (không có to).
• You should get more rest.
• You shouldn't drink coffee late at night.
• Should I take this medicine before or after meals?

**Grammar 2 – should / shouldn't for advice:** should + base verb (no “to”).
• You should get more rest.
• You shouldn't drink coffee late at night.
• Should I take this medicine before or after meals?
**Phát âm – chữ viết khác âm đọc:** stomach /ˈstʌm.ək/ (ch = /k/), ache /eɪk/, headache /ˈhed.eɪk/, cough /kɑːf/ (gh = /f/), medicine /ˈmed.ɪ.sən/. Học thuộc cách đọc, đừng đọc theo chữ.
**Pronunciation – spelling ≠ sound:** stomach /ˈstʌm.ək/ (ch = /k/), ache /eɪk/, headache /ˈhed.eɪk/, cough /kɑːf/ (gh = /f/), medicine /ˈmed.ɪ.sən/. Learn the sound; don't read the letters.

**Tự luyện ngoài app:**
• Nghe (20 phút): nghe 1 hội thoại bác sĩ – bệnh nhân, ghi triệu chứng, thuốc và lời dặn.
• Nói (25 phút): mô tả 3 triệu chứng (bắt đầu khi nào, đau ở đâu, mức độ), rồi đóng vai bác sĩ khuyên lại.
• Đọc (20 phút): đọc hướng dẫn trên 1 hộp thuốc, tìm liều dùng, tác dụng phụ, điều cần tránh.
• Viết (25 phút): viết tin nhắn 60–80 từ xin nghỉ học / nghỉ làm vì ốm.
• Từ vựng (15 phút): học 15 bộ phận cơ thể, chỉ vào người và nói tên.
• Thử thách (20 phút): làm “thẻ y tế du lịch” 6 câu trên điện thoại (I've got …, I'm taking …, I'm allergic to …).

**Practice outside the app:**
• Listening (20 min): listen to a doctor–patient dialogue; note symptoms, medicine and advice.
• Speaking (25 min): describe 3 symptoms (when they started, where it hurts, how bad), then play the doctor and give advice.
• Reading (20 min): read the leaflet on a medicine box; find the dose, side effects and what to avoid.
• Writing (25 min): write a 60–80-word message asking for sick leave from school or work.
• Vocabulary (15 min): learn 15 body parts; point and say them.
• Challenge (20 min): make a 6-sentence “travel health card” on your phone (I've got …, I'm taking …, I'm allergic to …).

warm.s: I've had a sore throat and a high fever since Saturday, and the medicine from the pharmacy hasn't helped at all.
q: Bệnh nhân bị sốt từ khi nào?
Since when has the patient had a fever?
e: “since Saturday” – since + mốc thời gian. Thuốc từ hiệu thuốc “hasn't helped at all” (không đỡ chút nào).
“since Saturday” – since + a starting point. The pharmacy medicine “hasn't helped at all”.

warm.s: I've had a headache since yesterday.
e: “I've had” = I have had (hiện tại hoàn thành). “since yesterday” vì yesterday là mốc thời gian.
“I've had” = I have had (present perfect). “since yesterday” because yesterday is a starting point.

warm.s: I'm allergic to penicillin.
e: “allergic to” – giới từ “to”, không phải “with”. allergic đọc /əˈlɝː.dʒɪk/.
“allergic to” – use “to”, not “with”. allergic is /əˈlɝː.dʒɪk/.

warm.s: How many times a day should I take this?
e: “a day” = mỗi ngày. Uống thuốc dùng “take”, không dùng “drink”.
“a day” = per day. You “take” medicine, not “drink” it.

warm.s: To stay healthy, I try to sleep seven hours a night, eat more vegetables and go swimming twice a week.
e: Câu hỏi: What do you do to stay healthy? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Nhấn vào các con số và hoạt động; “twice” /twaɪs/.
Question: What do you do to stay healthy? – Model answer. Stress the numbers and activities; “twice” /twaɪs/.

warm.s: With a normal cold, I think it's better to rest at home and drink lots of water, but you should see a doctor if the fever doesn't go down.
e: Câu hỏi: With a cold, is it better to see a doctor or rest at home? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Ngắt hơi sau “water”; nhấn “should”.
Question: With a cold, is it better to see a doctor or rest at home? – Model answer. Pause after “water”; stress “should”.

rd2.tx:
Patient: Good morning, doctor. I haven't felt well for about a week. I've had a bad cough since last Monday, and for the last two days I've also had a fever and a headache.
Doctor: I see. Have you taken any medicine?
Patient: Yes, I bought some cough syrup at the pharmacy, but it hasn't helped much.
Doctor: Let me check your chest. Hmm, it's a chest infection, but it isn't serious. I'm going to give you some antibiotics. Are you allergic to anything?
Patient: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
Doctor: Thank you for telling me. Then I'll give you a different one. Take one tablet three times a day after meals for five days. You should drink plenty of water and get more rest. You shouldn't go to work this week.
Patient: Thank you, doctor.
rd2.tr:
Bệnh nhân: Chào bác sĩ. Tôi thấy không khỏe khoảng một tuần nay rồi. Tôi bị ho nặng từ thứ Hai tuần trước, và hai ngày gần đây tôi còn bị sốt và đau đầu.
Bác sĩ: Tôi hiểu. Anh đã uống thuốc gì chưa?
Bệnh nhân: Rồi, tôi đã mua siro ho ở hiệu thuốc, nhưng không đỡ mấy.
Bác sĩ: Để tôi khám ngực anh. Hừm, anh bị nhiễm trùng phổi, nhưng không nghiêm trọng. Tôi sẽ kê cho anh thuốc kháng sinh. Anh có dị ứng với thứ gì không?
Bệnh nhân: Có, tôi dị ứng với penicillin.
Bác sĩ: Cảm ơn anh đã cho tôi biết. Vậy tôi sẽ kê loại khác. Uống một viên, ba lần một ngày sau bữa ăn, trong năm ngày. Anh nên uống nhiều nước và nghỉ ngơi nhiều hơn. Tuần này anh không nên đi làm.
Bệnh nhân: Cảm ơn bác sĩ.

q: Bệnh nhân bị ho từ khi nào?
Since when has the patient had a cough?
e: “I've had a bad cough since last Monday”. Sốt và đau đầu mới có “for the last two days”.
“I've had a bad cough since last Monday”. The fever and headache started “for the last two days”.

q: Vì sao bác sĩ đổi loại kháng sinh khác?
Why does the doctor choose a different antibiotic?
o: The patient is allergic to penicillin.
e: Bệnh nhân nói “I'm allergic to penicillin” nên bác sĩ “give you a different one”. Bệnh “isn't serious”.
The patient says “I'm allergic to penicillin”, so the doctor will “give you a different one”. The infection “isn't serious”.

q: Bệnh nhân phải uống thuốc thế nào?
How should the patient take the tablets?
o: Three times a day after meals for five days
Once a day before breakfast for a week
Three times a day before meals for two days
e: “Take one tablet three times a day after meals for five days.” Chú ý “after meals” (sau bữa ăn).
“Take one tablet three times a day after meals for five days.” Note “after meals”.
f: three times a day after meals

ex2.s: I've had a cough ___ three days, so I'm going to see a doctor this afternoon.
a: for
e: “three days” là khoảng thời gian → for. Dùng since với mốc (since Monday).
“three days” is a period → for. Use since with a starting point (since Monday).

ex2.s: You ___ drink more water and go to bed earlier if you want to feel better. (nên)
a: should
e: Lời khuyên: should + động từ nguyên mẫu, không có “to” (không nói “should to drink”).
Advice: should + base verb, with no “to” (not “should to drink”).

ex2.s: I've had a fever ___ Monday, and I still feel very weak and tired today.
a: since
e: “Monday” là mốc bắt đầu → since. Lỗi hay gặp: “from Monday” với thì hiện tại hoàn thành.
“Monday” is a starting point → since. A common mistake is “from Monday” with the present perfect.

ex2.s: My grandmother ___ in hospital since the beginning of the month, but the doctors say she is getting better.
e: Tình trạng bắt đầu từ đầu tháng và còn đến nay + since → hiện tại hoàn thành “has been”.
A situation from the start of the month until now + since → present perfect “has been”.

ex2.s: I have this pain in my stomach since Saturday, and I can't eat anything without feeling sick.
a: I've had this pain in my stomach since Saturday, and I can't eat anything without feeling sick.
I have had this pain in my stomach since Saturday, and I can't eat anything without feeling sick.
e: Có “since Saturday” và tình trạng vẫn còn → hiện tại hoàn thành “have had”, không phải hiện tại đơn “have”.
With “since Saturday” and a continuing situation → present perfect “have had”, not present simple “have”.

ex2.s: You shouldn't to take these tablets on an empty stomach because they can make you feel sick.
a: You shouldn't take these tablets on an empty stomach because they can make you feel sick.
You should not take these tablets on an empty stomach because they can make you feel sick.
e: Sau should / shouldn't là động từ nguyên mẫu không “to”.
After should / shouldn't use the base verb without “to”.

ex2.s: Tôi thấy chóng mặt.
a: I feel dizzy.
I'm feeling dizzy.
I feel a bit dizzy.
e: “chóng mặt” = dizzy, đi với “feel”. Không nói “I am dizzy feeling”.
“chóng mặt” = dizzy, used with “feel”.

ex2.s: Tôi cần đặt lịch khám bác sĩ.
a: I need to make a doctor's appointment.
I need to make an appointment with a doctor.
I need to book a doctor's appointment.
I need to make an appointment to see a doctor.
e: “đặt lịch hẹn” = make / book an appointment. Có thể nói “a doctor's appointment” hoặc “an appointment with a doctor”.
“đặt lịch hẹn” = make / book an appointment. Say “a doctor's appointment” or “an appointment with a doctor”.

ex2.s: Tôi đã bị đau họng được hai ngày rồi, nên bác sĩ bảo tôi không nên uống đồ lạnh.
a: I've had a sore throat for two days, so the doctor told me I shouldn't have cold drinks.
I've had a sore throat for two days, so the doctor said I shouldn't drink cold drinks.
I have had a sore throat for two days, so the doctor told me that I shouldn't have cold drinks.
I've had a sore throat for two days, so the doctor told me not to have cold drinks.
e: “được hai ngày rồi” → present perfect + for two days. “đau họng” = a sore throat; khuyên → shouldn't.
“for two days up to now” → present perfect + for. “đau họng” = a sore throat; advice → shouldn't.
f: I've had a sore throat for two days

q: Viết lại câu dùng “since”.
Rewrite the sentence using “since”.
ex2.s: My back started to hurt three days ago, on Friday, and it still hurts now.
a: My back has hurt since Friday.
My back has been hurting since Friday.
My back has hurt since Friday, three days ago.
My back has been hurting since Friday, three days ago.
e: Bắt đầu trong quá khứ + vẫn còn → hiện tại hoàn thành (has hurt / has been hurting) + since + mốc (Friday).
Started in the past + still true → present perfect (has hurt / has been hurting) + since + starting point (Friday).

ex2.s: If you|still|have|a fever|tomorrow,|you should|go back|to the doctor|for another check-up.
m: Nếu ngày mai bạn vẫn còn sốt, bạn nên quay lại gặp bác sĩ để kiểm tra lại.
If you still have a fever tomorrow, you should go back to the doctor for another check-up.
e: “still” đứng trước động từ “have”; mệnh đề khuyên dùng “you should + V”.
“still” goes before “have”; the advice clause uses “you should + verb”.
f: you should go back to the doctor

q: Viết khoảng 100 từ khuyên một người bạn hay bị mất ngủ: 5 lời khuyên dùng should / shouldn't.
Write about 100 words giving advice to a friend who can't sleep: 5 pieces of advice with should / shouldn't.
ex2.m:
Hi Mai,
I'm sorry you haven't slept well for weeks. Here is some advice. First, you shouldn't drink coffee or tea after lunch, because caffeine stays in your body for hours. Second, you should go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even at the weekend. You also shouldn't use your phone in bed – the light keeps your brain awake. You should do some exercise, like walking or swimming, but not late in the evening. Finally, if you still can't sleep after a month, you should see a doctor.
Take care,
Lan
e: Cần có: • 5 lời khuyên với should / shouldn't + V nguyên mẫu • lý do cho mỗi lời khuyên (because…) • từ nối thứ tự (First, Second, Finally) • mở đầu và kết thúc như tin nhắn bạn bè.
Include: • 5 pieces of advice with should / shouldn't + base verb • a reason for each (because…) • sequence words (First, Second, Finally) • a friendly opening and closing.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – câu điều kiện loại 1:** **If + hiện tại đơn, will + V** cho điều có thể xảy ra ở tương lai. Không dùng “will” trong mệnh đề If.
• If I pass, I'll apply for a scholarship.
• If you don't revise, you won't get a good grade.
• I'll celebrate if I pass the exam.

**Grammar 1 – first conditional:** **If + present simple, will + verb** for possible future results. Never use “will” in the if-clause.
• If I pass, I'll apply for a scholarship.
• If you don't revise, you won't get a good grade.
• I'll celebrate if I pass the exam.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – hiện tại tiếp diễn & so sánh ngang:** am/is/are + V-ing cho việc đang diễn ra quanh thời điểm nói (I'm revising for my exams these days). **as + adj + as** = bằng; **not as + adj + as** = không bằng.
• I'm majoring in economics.
• Online learning is as effective as classroom learning.
• My school wasn't as big as this university.

**Grammar 2 – present continuous & as … as:** am/is/are + -ing for things happening around now (I'm revising for my exams these days). **as + adj + as** = equal; **not as + adj + as** = less.
• I'm majoring in economics.
• Online learning is as effective as classroom learning.
• My school wasn't as big as this university.

**Phát âm – trọng âm di chuyển trong họ từ:** e**CON**omy /ɪˈkɑː.nə.mi/ → eco**NOM**ic /ˌiː.kəˈnɑː.mɪk/ → eco**NOM**ics. Tương tự: **PHO**tograph → pho**TO**graphy → photo**GRAPH**ic. Khi học từ mới, học cả trọng âm.

**Pronunciation – stress moves in word families:** e**CON**omy /ɪˈkɑː.nə.mi/ → eco**NOM**ic /ˌiː.kəˈnɑː.mɪk/ → eco**NOM**ics. Also: **PHO**tograph → pho**TO**graphy → photo**GRAPH**ic. Learn the stress with every new word.

**Tự luyện ngoài app:**
• Nghe (25 phút): nghe 1 bài phỏng vấn sinh viên về cuộc sống đại học (5–7 phút), tóm tắt 5 ý chính.
• Nói (25 phút): trả lời 2 phút “Online or face-to-face learning – which is better?” – 1 quan điểm, 2 lý do, 1 ví dụ.
• Đọc (25 phút): đọc 1 bài báo ngắn về hệ thống giáo dục một nước, gạch chân 10 từ mới.
• Viết (35 phút): viết 120–150 từ so sánh đại học Việt Nam với một nước khác.
• Từ vựng (15 phút): sơ đồ tư duy “school” → người, nơi chốn, hoạt động, giấy tờ.
• Thử thách (25 phút): xem 1 bài giảng 10 phút trên Coursera hoặc edX, ghi 5 ý chính.

**Practice outside the app:**
• Listening (25 min): listen to a 5–7-minute interview with a student about university life; summarise 5 main points.
• Speaking (25 min): answer for 2 minutes: “Online or face-to-face learning – which is better?” – 1 opinion, 2 reasons, 1 example.
• Reading (25 min): read a short article about one country's education system; underline 10 new words.
• Writing (35 min): write 120–150 words comparing Vietnamese universities with another country's.
• Vocabulary (15 min): mind map “school” → people, places, activities, documents.
• Challenge (25 min): watch a 10-minute lecture on Coursera or edX and note 5 key ideas.
tb: English
Tiếng Việt
I'm majoring in economics.
Tôi học chuyên ngành kinh tế.
I'm revising for my final exams.
Tôi đang ôn thi cuối kỳ.
If I pass, I'll apply for a scholarship.
Nếu đậu, tôi sẽ xin học bổng.
In my opinion, online learning is as effective as classroom learning.
Theo tôi, học online hiệu quả như học trên lớp.
I graduated from university last year.
Tôi tốt nghiệp đại học năm ngoái.
What's your favourite subject?
Môn học bạn thích nhất là gì?
I got a good grade in maths.
Tôi được điểm tốt môn toán.
vo: an area of study, e.g. maths
the mark you get in a test
school work you do at home
the main subject you study at university
money given to pay for study

warm.s: If I get an IELTS score of seven, I'll apply for a scholarship to study engineering in Australia next year.
q: Người nói sẽ làm gì nếu đạt 7.0 IELTS?
What will the speaker do if they get 7.0 in IELTS?
o: Xin học bổng học kỹ thuật ở Úc
Apply for a scholarship to study engineering in Australia
e: Câu điều kiện loại 1: “If I get …, I'll apply for a scholarship to study engineering in Australia”.
First conditional: “If I get …, I'll apply for a scholarship to study engineering in Australia”.

warm.s: I'm majoring in economics.
e: “major in” (Mỹ) = học chuyên ngành; Anh-Anh hay nói “I'm studying economics”. economics nhấn eco-NOM-ics.
“major in” (US) = have as your main subject; British English often says “I'm studying economics”. Stress eco-NOM-ics.

warm.s: I'm revising for my final exams.
e: “revise for” = ôn thi cho (Anh-Anh); Mỹ: “study for”. “final exams” = thi cuối kỳ.
“revise for” = study again for (UK); US: “study for”. “final exams” = end-of-term exams.

warm.s: If I pass, I'll apply for a scholarship.
e: Mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại “pass”, mệnh đề chính dùng “I'll”. “apply for” đi với giới từ for.
The if-clause uses present “pass”, the main clause “I'll”. “apply for” takes “for”.

warm.s: I really liked my literature teacher at school, but I didn't like the long hours and the huge amount of homework every evening.
e: Câu hỏi: What did you like and dislike about school? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Nhấn vào “liked” và “didn't like” để làm rõ sự đối lập.
Question: What did you like and dislike about school? – Model answer. Stress “liked” and “didn't like” to show the contrast.

warm.s: I'm learning English with an app every morning, and in the evening I watch videos with subtitles and write new words in a notebook.
e: Câu hỏi: How are you learning this language? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Hiện tại tiếp diễn “I'm learning” cho việc đang làm giai đoạn này.
Question: How are you learning this language? – Model answer. The present continuous “I'm learning” describes this period of your life.

rd2.tx: Hi everyone! My name is Quang and I'm a third-year student at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. I'm majoring in economics, and right now I'm revising for my final exams, which start next Monday. Every day I study in the library from eight until five. At lunchtime I usually eat with my classmates in the canteen. My favourite subject is statistics, but I find accounting really difficult. Some of my classes are online this year. In my opinion, online classes are as useful as face-to-face classes, but they aren't as fun because you can't chat with your friends. If I get good grades this term, I'll apply for a scholarship to do a master's degree in Japan. I'll graduate next summer, so wish me luck!
rd2.tr: Chào mọi người! Mình tên là Quang, sinh viên năm ba ở một trường đại học tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. Mình học chuyên ngành kinh tế, và hiện mình đang ôn thi cuối kỳ, bắt đầu vào thứ Hai tới. Ngày nào mình cũng học ở thư viện từ tám giờ đến năm giờ. Buổi trưa mình thường ăn với các bạn cùng lớp ở căng tin. Môn mình thích nhất là thống kê, nhưng mình thấy kế toán thật sự khó. Năm nay một số lớp của mình học online. Theo mình, lớp online hữu ích như lớp học trực tiếp, nhưng không vui bằng vì bạn không thể trò chuyện với bạn bè. Nếu kỳ này mình được điểm tốt, mình sẽ xin học bổng để học thạc sĩ ở Nhật Bản. Mình sẽ tốt nghiệp vào mùa hè tới, nên chúc mình may mắn nhé!

q: Quang thấy môn nào khó?
Which subject does Quang find difficult?
e: “My favourite subject is statistics, but I find accounting really difficult.” Thống kê là môn yêu thích.
“My favourite subject is statistics, but I find accounting really difficult.” Statistics is his favourite.

q: Quang nghĩ gì về lớp học online?
What does Quang think about online classes?
o: They are as useful as face-to-face classes but less fun.
They are more useful and more fun.
They are not useful at all.
e: “online classes are as useful as face-to-face classes, but they aren't as fun” – ngang nhau về hữu ích, kém về độ vui.
“online classes are as useful as face-to-face classes, but they aren't as fun” – equal in usefulness, less fun.

q: Điều gì xảy ra nếu Quang được điểm tốt kỳ này?
What will happen if Quang gets good grades this term?
o: He'll apply for a scholarship in Japan.
He'll start a job in a bank.
e: “If I get good grades this term, I'll apply for a scholarship to do a master's degree in Japan.”
“If I get good grades this term, I'll apply for a scholarship to do a master's degree in Japan.”

ex2.s: If I ___ the exam next week, I'll celebrate with my classmates at our favourite restaurant. (pass)
a: pass
e: Mệnh đề If ở câu điều kiện loại 1 dùng hiện tại đơn “pass”, không dùng “will pass”.
The if-clause of a first conditional uses present simple “pass”, not “will pass”.

ex2.s: I'm ___ for my final exams right now, so I can't go to the cinema with you tonight. (revise)
a: revising
e: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: am + V-ing. revise bỏ “e” rồi thêm -ing → revising.
Present continuous: am + -ing. revise drops the “e” → revising.

ex2.s: Online classes are as useful ___ face-to-face classes if students are motivated and well organised.
a: as
e: So sánh ngang: as + tính từ + as. Không dùng “than” hay “like”.
Equal comparison: as + adjective + as. Don't use “than” or “like”.

ex2.s: If you ___ your homework every evening, you won't need to study all night before the exam.
e: Mệnh đề If (loại 1) dùng hiện tại đơn “do”; “will do” sai vì will không đứng sau If.
The if-clause (first conditional) takes present simple “do”; “will do” is wrong after If.

ex2.s: If I will get a scholarship, I'll study in Australia for two years and then come back to Vietnam.
a: If I get a scholarship, I'll study in Australia for two years and then come back to Vietnam.
If I get a scholarship, I will study in Australia for two years and then come back to Vietnam.
e: Không dùng “will” trong mệnh đề If: “If I get”, không phải “If I will get”.
Don't use “will” in the if-clause: “If I get”, not “If I will get”.

ex2.s: My new school isn't as big than my old one, but the teachers are much friendlier and more helpful.
a: My new school isn't as big as my old one, but the teachers are much friendlier and more helpful.
e: Cấu trúc “not as … as” – phải dùng “as” ở cả hai vế, không trộn với “than”.
The structure is “not as … as” – use “as” both times; don't mix it with “than”.

ex2.s: Tôi tốt nghiệp đại học năm ngoái.
a: I graduated from university last year.
I graduated last year.
I graduated from college last year.
e: “graduate from + trường”. Có mốc “last year” → quá khứ đơn “graduated”.
“graduate from + school”. With “last year” → past simple “graduated”.

ex2.s: Môn học bạn thích nhất là gì?
a: What's your favourite subject?
What is your favourite subject?
What's your favorite subject?
What is your favorite subject?
e: “thích nhất” = favourite (Mỹ: favorite). Không nói “most like subject”.
“thích nhất” = favourite (US: favorite). Don't say “most like subject”.

ex2.s: Nếu bạn không ôn tập thường xuyên, bạn sẽ thấy kỳ thi cuối kỳ rất khó.
a: If you don't revise regularly, you'll find the final exam very difficult.
If you don't review regularly, you will find the final exams very difficult.
If you don't revise regularly, you will find the final exams very hard.
You'll find the final exam very difficult if you don't revise regularly.
e: Loại 1: If + hiện tại (don't revise), will + V (you'll find). “find + danh từ + tính từ” = thấy cái gì như thế nào.
First conditional: If + present (don't revise), will + verb (you'll find). “find + noun + adjective” = experience it as.
f: If you don't revise regularly, you'll find

ex2.s: In my opinion,|learning online|is|as effective as|learning in a classroom|if|students|are well organised.
m: Theo tôi, học online hiệu quả như học trên lớp nếu sinh viên biết tự tổ chức tốt.
In my opinion, learning online is as effective as learning in a classroom if students are well organised.
e: “learning online” (danh động từ) làm chủ ngữ; so sánh ngang “as effective as”.
The gerund “learning online” is the subject; equal comparison “as effective as”.

q: Viết thư xin học bổng khoảng 150 từ: bạn là ai, thành tích, lý do chọn ngành, kế hoạch sau khi học xong.
Write a scholarship application letter of about 150 words: who you are, your achievements, why you chose your subject, and your plans after you finish.
ex2.m:
Dear Scholarship Committee,
My name is Tran Minh Anh and I'm a third-year student at the University of Economics in Ho Chi Minh City, where I'm majoring in international business. I'm writing to apply for your Master's scholarship.
I have always worked hard at university. My average grade is 8.7 out of 10, and last year I won first prize in a national business case competition. I'm also the leader of our English club.
I chose international business because Vietnam is trading with more and more countries, and I want to help small Vietnamese companies sell their products abroad. If I get this scholarship, I'll study supply chain management for two years. After I graduate, I'll come back to Vietnam and work for a company that exports agricultural products.
Thank you for considering my application.
Yours faithfully,
Tran Minh Anh
e: Cần có: • giới thiệu bản thân và ngành học (hiện tại tiếp diễn: I'm majoring in…) • 2 thành tích cụ thể • lý do chọn ngành • kế hoạch dùng câu điều kiện loại 1 (If I get…, I'll…) • lời chào trang trọng.

Include: • who you are and your major (I'm majoring in…) • 2 concrete achievements • why you chose the subject • future plans with a first conditional (If I get…, I'll…) • a formal opening and closing.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – hiện tại hoàn thành với just, already, yet:** **just** (vừa mới) và **already** (đã rồi) đứng giữa have và V3; **yet** (chưa / đã … chưa) đứng cuối câu phủ định và câu hỏi.
• I've just changed my password.
• She has already posted the photos.
• Have you downloaded this app yet? – No, I haven't downloaded it yet.

**Grammar 1 – present perfect with just, already, yet:** **just** and **already** go between have and the past participle; **yet** goes at the end of negatives and questions.
• I've just changed my password.
• She has already posted the photos.
• Have you downloaded this app yet? – No, I haven't downloaded it yet.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – danh động từ làm chủ ngữ:** V-ing đứng đầu câu như một danh từ, động từ theo sau chia số ít.
• Using social media too much is bad for your sleep.
• Sharing passwords is dangerous.
• Learning with AI tools saves a lot of time.

**Grammar 2 – gerunds as subjects:** an -ing form can start a sentence like a noun; the verb after it is singular.
• Using social media too much is bad for your sleep.
• Sharing passwords is dangerous.
• Learning with AI tools saves a lot of time.

**Phát âm – trọng âm trước -tion, -logy:** trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết ngay trước đuôi: appli**CA**tion /ˌæp.ləˈkeɪ.ʃən/, infor**MA**tion, tech**NO**logy /tekˈnɑː.lə.dʒi/, bi**O**logy. Đuôi -tion đọc /ʃən/.

**Pronunciation – stress before -tion, -logy:** the stress falls on the syllable just before the ending: appli**CA**tion /ˌæp.ləˈkeɪ.ʃən/, infor**MA**tion, tech**NO**logy /tekˈnɑː.lə.dʒi/, bi**O**logy. -tion is said /ʃən/.

ex2.m:
Artificial intelligence has changed the way many people learn languages. On the one hand, it has a lot of advantages. Using an AI chatbot is like having a teacher who is available all day and never gets tired. It can correct your grammar immediately, explain new words and help you practise conversations about any topic. AI translation apps have also made travelling much easier.
On the other hand, there are some disadvantages. If students use AI to write their homework, they don't really learn anything. AI tools sometimes make mistakes, and beginners can't always notice them. In addition, talking to a computer isn't the same as talking to a real person, so it doesn't help much with confidence.
In my opinion, AI is a great tool, but it can't replace hard work. I've used it for a year to check my writing, and my English has improved, but I still speak with real people every week.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – quá khứ đơn:** động từ có quy tắc thêm **-ed** (celebrate → celebrated, visit → visited); động từ bất quy tắc phải học thuộc (go → went, see → saw, give → gave, eat → ate). Phủ định và câu hỏi: **didn't / Did + V nguyên mẫu**.
• Last year we celebrated Christmas in London.
• I saw a great film yesterday.
• Did you go to the concert last weekend?

**Grammar 1 – past simple:** regular verbs add **-ed** (celebrate → celebrated, visit → visited); irregular verbs must be learnt (go → went, see → saw, give → gave, eat → ate). Negatives and questions: **didn't / Did + base verb**.
• Last year we celebrated Christmas in London.
• I saw a great film yesterday.
• Did you go to the concert last weekend?

**Ngữ pháp 2 – so sánh nhất:** **the + adj-est** với tính từ ngắn (the biggest, the busiest); **the most + adj** với tính từ dài (the most important, the most famous). Bất quy tắc: good → the best, bad → the worst. Hay đi với **in** + nơi chốn, **of** + nhóm/khoảng thời gian.
• Tet is the most important festival in Vietnam.
• It was the best concert of the year.

**Grammar 2 – superlatives:** **the + adj-est** for short adjectives (the biggest, the busiest); **the most + adj** for long ones (the most important, the most famous). Irregular: good → the best, bad → the worst. Often followed by **in** + place or **of** + group/period.
• Tet is the most important festival in Vietnam.
• It was the best concert of the year.

**Phát âm – đuôi -ed:** /t/ sau âm vô thanh (watched, danced, liked); /d/ sau âm hữu thanh và nguyên âm (played, enjoyed, opened); /ɪd/ chỉ sau **t** và **d** (visited, celebrated, decided). Đừng thêm /ɪd/ cho mọi động từ: watched đọc /wɑːtʃt/ (1 âm tiết).

**Pronunciation – the -ed ending:** /t/ after voiceless sounds (watched, danced, liked); /d/ after voiced sounds and vowels (played, enjoyed); /ɪd/ only after **t** and **d** (visited, celebrated, decided). Don't add /ɪd/ to every verb: watched is /wɑːtʃt/ (one syllable).

“because people believe he brings good luck” – this is the first-visitor custom.
f: people believe he brings good luck

q: Người viết cảm thấy thế nào về tuần Tết?
How did the writer feel about the Tet week?
o: It was the happiest week of the year.
It was too busy and tiring.
It was boring without the city.
e: “It was the happiest week of the year, and I didn't want to go back to the city.” – happy → the happiest.
“It was the happiest week of the year, and I didn't want to go back to the city.” – happy → the happiest.
f: the happiest week of the year

ex2.s: Last year we ___ Christmas in London with some friends, and it was the first time I saw real snow. (celebrate)
a: celebrated
e: “Last year” → quá khứ đơn. celebrate tận cùng bằng e nên chỉ thêm -d: celebrated /ˈsel.ə.breɪ.t̬ɪd/.
“Last year” → past simple. celebrate ends in e, so just add -d: celebrated.

ex2.s: Tet is ___ most important festival in Vietnam, and most people travel home to spend it with their families.
a: the
e: So sánh nhất luôn có “the”: the most important. Lỗi hay gặp: bỏ “the”.
Superlatives always need “the”: the most important. A common mistake is dropping it.

ex2.s: I ___ a great film at the cinema yesterday, and I want to watch it again with my brother. (see)
a: saw
e: see là động từ bất quy tắc: see → saw → seen. Có “yesterday” → quá khứ đơn “saw”.
see is irregular: see → saw → seen. With “yesterday” → past simple “saw”.

ex2.s: The Hoi An Lantern Festival is one of ___ events in central Vietnam, so the old town is very crowded every month.
e: “one of + the + so sánh nhất + danh từ số nhiều”. “the more popular” là so sánh hơn; thiếu “the” là sai.
“one of + the + superlative + plural noun”. “the more popular” is comparative; dropping “the” is wrong.
f: one of the most popular events

ex2.s: We goed to the museum on Saturday and learned a lot about the history of the city.
a: We went to the museum on Saturday and learned a lot about the history of the city.
We went to the museum on Saturday and learnt a lot about the history of the city.
e: go là động từ bất quy tắc: quá khứ là “went”, không phải “goed”.
go is irregular: the past form is “went”, not “goed”.

ex2.s: It was the most good concert I have ever been to, and the singer talked to the audience between every song.
a: It was the best concert I have ever been to, and the singer talked to the audience between every song.
It was the best concert I've ever been to, and the singer talked to the audience between every song.
e: good là tính từ bất quy tắc: good → better → the best. Không nói “the most good”.
good is irregular: good → better → the best. Never say “the most good”.

ex2.s: Người Việt thường lì xì cho trẻ em dịp Tết.
a: At Tet, Vietnamese people usually give children lucky money.
Vietnamese people usually give children lucky money at Tet.
Vietnamese people usually give lucky money to children at Tet.
At Tet, Vietnamese people usually give lucky money to children.
e: “lì xì” = give lucky money. Cấu trúc give + người + vật hoặc give + vật + to + người.
“lì xì” = give lucky money. Use give + person + thing or give + thing + to + person.

ex2.s: Bạn thích thể loại nhạc nào?
a: What kind of music do you like?
What type of music do you like?
What sort of music do you like?
e: “thể loại” = kind / type / sort of. Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn cần “do”.
“thể loại” = kind / type / sort of. Present simple questions need “do”.

ex2.s: Năm ngoái chúng tôi đến thăm Huế trong dịp lễ hội và đó là chuyến đi thú vị nhất mà tôi từng có.
a: Last year we visited Hue during the festival, and it was the most interesting trip I have ever had.
Last year we visited Hue during the festival and it was the most interesting trip I've ever had.
Last year we went to Hue during the festival, and it was the most exciting trip I've ever had.
Last year we visited Hue during the festival, and it was the best trip I have ever had.
e: “Năm ngoái” → quá khứ đơn (visited/went). “thú vị nhất mà tôi từng có” → the most interesting … I have ever had.
“Last year” → past simple (visited/went). “the most … I've ever had” = superlative + present perfect with ever.
f: the most interesting trip I have ever had

ex2.s: During Tet,|people|usually|go back|to their hometowns|to be|with their families|and visit|their relatives.
m: Dịp Tết, mọi người thường về quê để sum họp với gia đình và thăm họ hàng.
During Tet, people usually go back to their hometowns to be with their families and visit their relatives.
e: “usually” đứng trước động từ “go back”; “to be with” chỉ mục đích.
“usually” goes before “go back”; “to be with” expresses purpose.

q: Viết khoảng 150 từ so sánh Tết Việt Nam với Christmas: 2 điểm giống, 2 điểm khác.
Write about 150 words comparing Vietnamese Tet with Christmas: 2 similarities and 2 differences.
ex2.m:
Tet and Christmas are the most important holidays in Vietnam and in many Western countries. They are similar in two ways. First, both are family holidays: people travel long distances to go home and spend time with their parents and grandparents. Second, both have special food and gifts. At Christmas, families eat roast turkey and give presents, while at Tet we make banh chung and give children lucky money.
However, there are also some big differences. Christmas is on the same day every year, 25 December, but the date of Tet changes because it follows the lunar calendar. Also, Christmas has religious roots, while Tet is more about welcoming the new year, honouring ancestors and hoping for good luck.
Last year I celebrated Christmas with a friend's family in Australia. It was very hot, so we had a barbecue on the beach! It was fun, but for me Tet is still the most meaningful holiday.
e: Cần có: • 2 điểm giống (both…, similar) • 2 điểm khác (however, while, but) • ít nhất 2 câu so sánh nhất (the most important…) • ít nhất 2 động từ quá khứ đơn kể trải nghiệm thật.
Include: • 2 similarities (both…, similar) • 2 differences (however, while, but) • at least 2 superlatives (the most important…) • at least 2 past simple verbs describing a real experience.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – will và be going to**
• **will**: quyết định ngay lúc nói hoặc lời hứa: Don't worry, I'll send it today.
• **be going to**: kế hoạch đã có từ trước: We're going to start a new project next month.
• Ví dụ: I'll call the client now. / Lan is going to write the monthly report.

**Grammar 1 – will and be going to**
• **will**: a decision made at the moment of speaking, or a promise: Don't worry, I'll send it today.
• **be going to**: a plan made before: We're going to start a new project next month.
• Examples: I'll call the client now. / Lan is going to write the monthly report.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – yêu cầu lịch sự**
• **Could you + V?**: Could you help me with this?
• **Would you mind + V-ing?**: Would you mind opening the window? (KHÔNG nói “mind to open”)
• Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành để báo thay đổi: The meeting has been moved to 3 p.m.

**Grammar 2 – polite requests**
• **Could you + verb?**: Could you help me with this?
• **Would you mind + -ing?**: Would you mind opening the window? (NOT “mind to open”)
• Present perfect passive to announce changes: The meeting has been moved to 3 p.m.

**Phát âm**
• Câu yêu cầu lịch sự thường lên giọng ở cuối: Could you help me? ↗
• Nối âm **Could_you** đọc thành /kʊdʒu/, **Would_you** thành /wʊdʒu/.
• colleague /ˈkɑː.liːɡ/ – trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu.

**Pronunciation**
• Polite requests usually rise at the end: Could you help me? ↗
• Linking: **Could_you** sounds like /kʊdʒu/, **Would_you** like /wʊdʒu/.
• colleague /ˈkɑː.liːɡ/ – stress on the first syllable.

**Tự luyện ngoài app**
• Nghe (25 phút): nghe 1 cuộc họp mẫu, ghi biên bản: ai làm gì, hạn khi nào.
• Nói (25 phút): báo cáo tiến độ 1 dự án trong 2 phút: đã làm, đang làm, sẽ làm, khó khăn.
• Đọc (20 phút): đọc 3 email công việc mẫu, xác định mục đích, việc cần làm, hạn chót.
• Viết (35 phút): viết 2 email 80–100 từ: xin nghỉ phép và xin lùi hạn nộp báo cáo.
• Từ vựng (15 phút): viết 15 chức danh và phòng ban (accounting, HR, marketing …).
• Thử thách 7 ngày: đổi ngôn ngữ email/lịch/bảng tính sang tiếng Anh, ghi 20 từ mới trong menu.

**Practice outside the app**
• Listening (25 min): listen to a sample meeting and take minutes: who does what, by when.
• Speaking (25 min): give a 2-minute progress report on a project: done, in progress, next, problems.
• Reading (20 min): read 3 sample work emails; find the purpose, the action and the deadline.
• Writing (35 min): write 2 emails of 80–100 words: asking for leave and asking to extend a report deadline.
• Vocabulary (15 min): write 15 job titles and departments (accounting, HR, marketing …).
• 7-day challenge: switch your email, calendar or spreadsheet to English and note 20 new menu words.

The meeting has been moved to 3 p.m.

Tuần này tôi phải tăng ca hai buổi.
Would you mind checking my report?
Phiền anh xem giúp báo cáo của tôi được không?

Ai phụ trách dự án này?
I'd like to ask for a day off next Monday.
